headline: Preprint measures claim overstatement in research-agent reports and tests document reading
summary: An Oct 26 preprint introduces SmoothScore, an LLM-assisted method for checking whether research-report claims preserve the scope and strength of their cited evidence. On ResearcherBench, the authors report that 27.4–93.4% of claims from four selected systems score at least 3 on its 1–5 smoothing scale, with higher rates for some other systems and datasets. In a 73-claim human check, exact agreement between the judge and one annotator was 56%. A 61-question experiment reports less smoothing when tested systems receive cited documents plus instructions than with WebSearch alone. These are author-reported results from selected benchmarks; the judge is not established as ground truth, and the linked code/data repository currently has no implementation or dataset available.
